name: agent_night20_r1p1_first_touch_conversion
idea: This mirrors the target definition at the item level. Column one is the smoothed lift of P(cart or purchase within 24h | user's first touch of the item in the last 7 days). Column two is the share of the item's recent acquirers who first touched it no more than 24h before acquiring, i.e. how often the item is bought by people who were new to it.
sql: WITH ft AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, MIN(event_time) AS t0, MIN(event_time) FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase')) AS tcp FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY product_id, user_id), coh AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t0 >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND t0 < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS n_new, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t0 >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND t0 < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND tcp < t0 + INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS k_new, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tcp >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS n_acq, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tcp >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND t0 >= tcp - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS k_quick FROM ft GROUP BY product_id), g AS (SELECT SUM(k_new)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_new), 0) AS p_new, SUM(k_quick)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n_acq), 0) AS p_quick FROM coh) SELECT c.product_id, ((c.k_new + 20.0 * g.p_new) / (c.n_new + 20.0)) / NULLIF(g.p_new, 0) AS f_x_i_first_touch_conv_lift_7d, (c.k_quick + 10.0 * g.p_quick) / (c.n_acq + 10.0) AS f_x_i_quick_acq_share_7d FROM coh c CROSS JOIN g WHERE c.n_new > 0 OR c.n_acq > 0

name: agent_night20_r1p2_coacq_cf
idea: This is item-item similarity from co-acquisition rather than co-view: a cosine over users who carted or bought both items in the last 14 days. It is applied to the user's 10 latest touched items, so it surfaces complements and accessories that the co-view features miss.
sql: WITH cp AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) AS rn FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, product_id), cpc AS (SELECT user_id, product_id FROM cp WHERE rn <= 20), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM cpc GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM cpc a JOIN cpc b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.product_id <> b.product_id GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cos FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pr.pa ORDER BY pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) DESC) <= 20), seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id FROM (SELECT user_id, product_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) AS rn FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id) WHERE rn <= 10) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cos) AS f_x_cf_coacq_cos_max, LN(1 + SUM(nb.co)) AS f_x_cf_coacq_co_log FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r1p3_buyer_price_profile
idea: This describes the price taste of the item's buyers: the mean and spread of their median viewed log price, and the gap between that and the item's own log price. The model can match it against u_log_price_med_view_7d to tell which price-tier audiences the item converts.
sql: WITH acq AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), up AS (SELECT user_id, MEDIAN(LN(price::DOUBLE + 1)) AS ulp FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND event_type = 'view' AND price > 0 AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM acq) GROUP BY user_id), ip AS (SELECT product_id, LN(MEDIAN(price::DOUBLE) + 1) AS ilp FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND price > 0 AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM acq) GROUP BY product_id) SELECT a.product_id, AVG(up.ulp) AS f_x_i_buyer_logprice_mean_14d, AVG(up.ulp) - MAX(ip.ilp) AS f_x_i_buyer_vs_item_logprice_14d, COALESCE(STDDEV_POP(up.ulp), 0) AS f_x_i_buyer_logprice_std_14d FROM acq a JOIN up ON up.user_id = a.user_id JOIN ip ON ip.product_id = a.product_id GROUP BY a.product_id

name: agent_night20_r1p4_new_reach
idea: This measures the item's pull on new audiences, which is mostly view-based and therefore immune to the cart logging shift. It gives the share of the item's last-24h users who touched it for the first time in 14 days, plus the trend and log volume of those first-time users against the item's 7-day daily average.
sql: WITH ft AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, MIN(event_time) AS t0, MAX(event_time) AS t1 FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY product_id, user_id), a AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t0 >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS new1, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t1 >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS act1, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t0 >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS new7 FROM ft GROUP BY product_id) SELECT product_id, (new1 + 0.5) / (act1 + 1.0) AS f_x_i_new_reach_share_1d, LN((new1 + 1.0) / (new7 / 7.0 + 1.0)) AS f_x_i_new_reach_trend_1v7, LN(1.0 + new1) AS f_x_i_new_reach_1d_log FROM a WHERE new7 > 0 OR act1 > 0

name: agent_night20_r1p5_cp_staleness
idea: This is a stock-out or demand-stop detector: the log hours since the item's last cart or purchase, and that time divided by the item's expected inter-acquisition gap from its 7-day acquirer count. Normally popular items that suddenly go quiet score high.
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lcp, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS n7 FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY product_id) SELECT product_id, LN(1 + date_diff('second', lcp, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0) AS f_x_i_log_hours_since_last_cp, LN(1 + (date_diff('second', lcp, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0) * (n7 + 0.5) / 168.0) AS f_x_i_cp_staleness_ratio FROM a

name: agent_night20_r2p1_cmp_session_win_lift
idea: Choice share under comparison: in 14d sessions where a user viewed at least 2 items of one category and carted or bought something there, this is how often this item was the chosen one versus a uniform-choice expectation, plus the log number of such comparison sessions; it is a normalised ratio, so the cart level shift largely cancels.
sql: WITH sv AS (SELECT user_session, category_id, product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('cart','purchase') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acq FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_session, category_id, product_id), sc AS (SELECT user_session, category_id, COUNT(*) AS n_items, SUM(acq) AS n_acq FROM sv GROUP BY user_session, category_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 AND SUM(acq) >= 1), x AS (SELECT sv.product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_cmp, SUM(sv.acq) AS k_win, SUM(sc.n_acq::DOUBLE / sc.n_items) AS e_win FROM sv JOIN sc ON sc.user_session = sv.user_session AND sc.category_id = sv.category_id GROUP BY sv.product_id) SELECT product_id, (k_win + 2.0) / (e_win + 2.0) AS f_x_i_cmp_win_lift_14d, LN(1.0 + n_cmp) AS f_x_i_cmp_sessions_log_14d FROM x

name: agent_night20_r2p2_cp_category_complement
idea: Category-level complement graph from acquisitions: lift of P(first cart/purchase in category c2 within 3 days after one in c1) over 14 days, applied from the categories the user acquired in the last 7 days to the top 40 acquired products of each complementary category; this captures accessory demand such as phone to case that view-based links miss.
sql: WITH ac AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, MIN(event_time) AS t0 FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, category_id), nu AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::DOUBLE AS n FROM ac), cu AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS nc FROM ac GROUP BY category_id), pr AS (SELECT a.category_id AS c1, b.category_id AS c2, COUNT(*) AS co FROM ac a JOIN ac b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.category_id <> b.category_id AND b.t0 > a.t0 AND b.t0 <= a.t0 + INTERVAL 3 DAY GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5), lf AS (SELECT c1, c2, co, lift FROM (SELECT pr.c1, pr.c2, pr.co, (pr.co::DOUBLE / x.nc) / ((y.nc + 1.0) / nu.n) AS lift FROM pr JOIN cu x ON x.category_id = pr.c1 JOIN cu y ON y.category_id = pr.c2 CROSS JOIN nu) WHERE lift > 1.0 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c1 ORDER BY lift DESC) <= 3), seed AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, category_id AS c1 FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users)), uc AS (SELECT s.user_id, l.c2, MAX(l.lift) AS lift, SUM(l.co) AS co FROM seed s JOIN lf l ON l.c1 = s.c1 GROUP BY s.user_id, l.c2), tp AS (SELECT category_id, product_id FROM (SELECT category_id, product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY category_id, product_id) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY n DESC) <= 40) SELECT uc.user_id, tp.product_id, MAX(LN(uc.lift)) AS f_x_uc_cp_complement_lift_max, LN(1.0 + SUM(uc.co)) AS f_x_uc_cp_complement_co_log FROM uc JOIN tp ON tp.category_id = uc.c2 GROUP BY uc.user_id, tp.product_id

name: agent_night20_r2p3_acq_seed_coview_cf
idea: Session co-view neighbours (cosine, 7d, sessions of 2-30 items) of the user's 5 latest carted or bought items rather than latest views, with recency decay (72h) on the seed acquisition; this surfaces what people browse alongside things the user actually committed to, even when those items left the 20-latest-views window.
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 5), sp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), ss AS (SELECT user_session FROM sp GROUP BY user_session HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), spf AS (SELECT sp.user_session, sp.product_id FROM sp JOIN ss ON ss.user_session = sp.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM spf GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM spf a JOIN spf b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cs FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cs FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cs DESC) <= 30) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cs) AS f_x_cf_acqseed_cv_cos_max, SUM(nb.cs * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 72.0)) AS f_x_cf_acqseed_cv_cos_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r2p4_revisit_consideration
idea: Consideration depth from views only, so it is immune to the cart shift: the smoothed lift over the category of the share of the item's 7d viewers who came back to it in 2 or more distinct sessions, plus the log of views per viewer.
sql: WITH v AS (SELECT product_id, category_id, user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) AS ns, COUNT(*) AS nv FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id, category_id, user_id), it AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS nu, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ns >= 2) AS nrep, SUM(nv) AS nv FROM v GROUP BY product_id), ct AS (SELECT category_id, SUM(nrep)::DOUBLE / SUM(nu) AS p FROM it GROUP BY category_id) SELECT it.product_id, ((it.nrep + 10.0 * ct.p) / (it.nu + 10.0)) / NULLIF(ct.p, 0) AS f_x_i_revisit_lift_cat_7d, LN(it.nv::DOUBLE / it.nu) AS f_x_i_views_per_viewer_7d FROM it JOIN ct ON ct.category_id = it.category_id

name: agent_night20_r2p5_view_dwell_time
idea: Page dwell: the smoothed mean log seconds (capped at 600) between a view of the item and the next event in the same session over 7 days, and its gap to the category mean; long dwell signals serious evaluation and comes from views, so it is stable across the cart logging shift.
sql: WITH e AS (SELECT product_id, category_id, event_type, date_diff('second', event_time, LEAD(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_session ORDER BY event_time)) AS dt FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), d AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS category_id, SUM(LN(1.0 + LEAST(dt, 600))) AS sl, COUNT(*) AS n FROM e WHERE event_type = 'view' AND dt IS NOT NULL AND dt >= 0 GROUP BY product_id), c AS (SELECT category_id, SUM(sl) / SUM(n) AS cm FROM d GROUP BY category_id) SELECT d.product_id, (d.sl + 5.0 * c.cm) / (d.n + 5.0) AS f_x_i_dwell_log_mean_7d, (d.sl + 5.0 * c.cm) / (d.n + 5.0) - c.cm AS f_x_i_dwell_vs_cat_7d FROM d JOIN c ON c.category_id = d.category_id

name: agent_night20_r3p1_view_session_last_choice
idea: View-only decision signal immune to the cart shift: in 7d sessions where a user viewed 3 or more items of one category, this is how often the item was the last one viewed in that category (the settled choice) against a uniform expectation, how that compares with being viewed first (search-position bias), and the log number of such comparison sessions.
sql: WITH sv AS (SELECT user_session, category_id, product_id, MIN(event_time) AS ft, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_session, category_id, product_id), sc AS (SELECT user_session, category_id, COUNT(*) AS n, ARG_MAX(product_id, lt) AS last_p, ARG_MIN(product_id, ft) AS first_p FROM sv GROUP BY user_session, category_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), x AS (SELECT sv.product_id, COUNT(*) AS n_cmp, SUM(CASE WHEN sv.product_id = sc.last_p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS k_last, SUM(CASE WHEN sv.product_id = sc.first_p THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS k_first, SUM(1.0 / sc.n) AS e FROM sv JOIN sc ON sc.user_session = sv.user_session AND sc.category_id = sv.category_id GROUP BY sv.product_id) SELECT product_id, (k_last + 3.0) / (e + 3.0) AS f_x_i_last_viewed_lift_7d, (k_last + 3.0) / (k_first + 3.0) AS f_x_i_last_vs_first_7d, LN(1.0 + n_cmp) AS f_x_i_view_cmp_sessions_log_7d FROM x

name: agent_night20_r3p2_intraday_momentum_12h
idea: Very short-term momentum just before the anchor. Column one compares distinct viewers in the last 12h with the same 12h of the previous day, normalised by global traffic. Column two is the item's share of cart/purchase actors in the last 12h against its 7d share, a share ratio so the global cart level cancels.
sql: WITH v AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AS v12, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 36 HOUR AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AS v12y FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id), a AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 12 HOUR) AS a12, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS a7 FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id), g AS (SELECT SUM(a12)::DOUBLE AS g12, SUM(a7)::DOUBLE AS g7 FROM a), gv AS (SELECT SUM(v12)::DOUBLE AS s12, SUM(v12y)::DOUBLE AS s12y FROM v) SELECT v.product_id, LN((v.v12 + 1.0) / (v.v12y * gv.s12 / NULLIF(gv.s12y, 0) + 1.0)) AS f_x_i_view_mom_12h_vs_yday, LN((COALESCE(a.a12, 0) + 0.5) / (COALESCE(a.a7, 0) * g.g12 / NULLIF(g.g7, 0) + 0.5)) AS f_x_i_acq_share_12h_vs_7d FROM v LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id = v.product_id CROSS JOIN g CROSS JOIN gv

name: agent_night20_r3p3_user_user_cf_acq
idea: User-user collaborative filtering, unlike the existing item-item links: up to 30 neighbour users are found through overlap on the user's 10 latest items (niche items weighted by 1/log degree, hubs dropped), and their cart/purchase actions in the last 3 days are aggregated into a normalised weight share and a within-user rank.
sql: WITH sd AS (SELECT user_id, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 10), iv AS (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, user_id FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM sd)), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM iv GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 60), nb AS (SELECT sd.user_id AS u, iv.user_id AS v, SUM(1.0 / LN(1.0 + deg.n)) AS w FROM sd JOIN deg ON deg.product_id = sd.product_id JOIN iv ON iv.product_id = sd.product_id AND iv.user_id <> sd.user_id GROUP BY sd.user_id, iv.user_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.user_id ORDER BY SUM(1.0 / LN(1.0 + deg.n)) DESC) <= 30), uw AS (SELECT u, SUM(w) AS wt FROM nb GROUP BY u), na AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id AS v, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT v FROM nb)), sc AS (SELECT nb.u AS user_id, na.product_id, SUM(nb.w) AS s FROM nb JOIN na ON na.v = nb.v GROUP BY nb.u, na.product_id) SELECT sc.user_id, sc.product_id, sc.s / uw.wt AS f_x_uu_acq_wshare, (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sc.user_id ORDER BY sc.s DESC))::DOUBLE AS f_x_uu_acq_rank FROM sc JOIN uw ON uw.u = sc.user_id

name: agent_night20_r3p4_brand_cat_price_sibling
idea: Detects near-duplicate variants (colour or storage versions of the same model): for the top-50 products of the user's 3 latest category+brand combos, this gives the minimum log-price distance to items the user viewed in that same category and brand in the last 3 days, plus a price-and-recency kernel sum; this joint brand+category+price match is not captured by the separate ub_ and up_ features.
sql: WITH uv AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand, LN(price::DOUBLE + 1) AS lp, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) AND brand IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 GROUP BY user_id, category_id, brand, LN(price::DOUBLE + 1)), ucb AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand FROM uv GROUP BY user_id, category_id, brand QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(lt) DESC) <= 3), ip AS (SELECT product_id, category_id, brand, LN(MEDIAN(price::DOUBLE) + 1) AS lp FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND brand IS NOT NULL AND price > 0 GROUP BY product_id, category_id, brand QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id, brand ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC) <= 50), pr AS (SELECT ucb.user_id, ip.product_id, ip.category_id, ip.brand, ip.lp FROM ucb JOIN ip ON ip.category_id = ucb.category_id AND ip.brand = ucb.brand) SELECT pr.user_id, pr.product_id, MIN(ABS(pr.lp - uv.lp)) AS f_x_ubc_price_dist_min, SUM(EXP(-ABS(pr.lp - uv.lp) / 0.1) * EXP(-date_diff('second', uv.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 24.0)) AS f_x_ubc_sibling_kernel FROM pr JOIN uv ON uv.user_id = pr.user_id AND uv.category_id = pr.category_id AND uv.brand = pr.brand GROUP BY pr.user_id, pr.product_id

name: agent_night20_r3p5_category_search_depth
idea: How many distinct same-category items acquirers typically view before their first cart/purchase in the category (category-level log depth), and whether this item is a deliberated or an impulse choice relative to that norm; combined with uc_distinct_viewed_7d, it tells the model when a user's search is ripe to convert.
sql: WITH ac AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, MIN(event_time) AS t0, ARG_MIN(product_id, event_time) AS p FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, category_id), vw AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, product_id, MIN(event_time) AS fv FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM ac) GROUP BY user_id, category_id, product_id), d AS (SELECT ac.user_id, ac.category_id, ac.p, COUNT(vw.product_id) AS depth FROM ac LEFT JOIN vw ON vw.user_id = ac.user_id AND vw.category_id = ac.category_id AND vw.fv < ac.t0 AND vw.product_id <> ac.p GROUP BY ac.user_id, ac.category_id, ac.p), ct AS (SELECT category_id, AVG(LN(1.0 + depth)) AS cd FROM d GROUP BY category_id), it AS (SELECT p AS product_id, SUM(LN(1.0 + depth)) AS sdp, COUNT(*) AS n FROM d GROUP BY p), pc AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS category_id FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY product_id) SELECT pc.product_id, ct.cd AS f_x_i_cat_search_depth_14d, (COALESCE(it.sdp, 0) + 5.0 * ct.cd) / (COALESCE(it.n, 0) + 5.0) - ct.cd AS f_x_i_search_depth_vs_cat_14d FROM pc JOIN ct ON ct.category_id = pc.category_id LEFT JOIN it ON it.product_id = pc.product_id

name: agent_night20_r4p1_acq_regularity_7d
idea: Steady sellers versus spiky ones. The first column counts the days in the last 7 on which the item had any cart/purchase actor. The second is the coefficient of variation of the item's daily share of all acquirers, so the cart logging level cancels.
sql: WITH e AS (SELECT product_id, user_id, CAST(date_diff('second', event_time, TIMESTAMP '{t}') // 86400 AS INTEGER) AS dd FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY), pd AS (SELECT product_id, dd, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM e GROUP BY product_id, dd), gd AS (SELECT dd, SUM(n)::DOUBLE AS g FROM pd GROUP BY dd), s AS (SELECT pd.product_id, pd.n / gd.g AS sh FROM pd JOIN gd ON gd.dd = pd.dd) SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS f_x_i_acq_active_days_7d, SQRT(GREATEST(SUM(sh * sh) / 7.0 - POWER(SUM(sh) / 7.0, 2), 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(sh) / 7.0, 0) AS f_x_i_acq_share_cv_7d FROM s GROUP BY product_id

name: agent_night20_r4p2_cat_acq_concentration
idea: Describes how winner-take-all the candidate's category is. It gives the Herfindahl index of the category's 7d cart/purchase actors over its items, plus the item's smoothed log share and log rank inside its category for all products in the category, not only those of the user's top categories.
sql: WITH pc AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS category_id FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id), a AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id), pa AS (SELECT pc.product_id, pc.category_id, COALESCE(a.n, 0) AS n FROM pc LEFT JOIN a ON a.product_id = pc.product_id WHERE pc.category_id IS NOT NULL), c AS (SELECT category_id, SUM(n)::DOUBLE AS cn, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n > 0) AS ni FROM pa GROUP BY category_id), h AS (SELECT pa.category_id, SUM(POWER(pa.n / NULLIF(c.cn, 0), 2)) AS hhi FROM pa JOIN c ON c.category_id = pa.category_id GROUP BY pa.category_id), r AS (SELECT product_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY n DESC) AS rk FROM pa) SELECT pa.product_id, h.hhi AS f_x_i_cat_acq_hhi_7d, LN((pa.n + 0.5) / (c.cn + 0.5 * (c.ni + 1))) AS f_x_i_acq_share_in_cat_7d, LN(r.rk::DOUBLE) AS f_x_i_acq_rank_in_cat_log_7d FROM pa JOIN c ON c.category_id = pa.category_id JOIN h ON h.category_id = pa.category_id JOIN r ON r.product_id = pa.product_id

name: agent_night20_r4p3_weekday_seasonality_14d
idea: Weekly seasonality for the target day: the item's and its category's share of cart/purchase actors on the same weekday 7 and 14 days ago, relative to their 14d share. It is normalised by global daily acquirers so the cart shift cancels.
sql: WITH e AS (SELECT product_id, category_id, user_id, CAST(date_diff('second', event_time, TIMESTAMP '{t}') // 86400 AS INTEGER) AS dd FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), pd AS (SELECT product_id, dd, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM e GROUP BY product_id, dd), cd AS (SELECT category_id, dd, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM e GROUP BY category_id, dd), gd AS (SELECT dd, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::DOUBLE AS g FROM e GROUP BY dd), gw AS (SELECT SUM(g) FILTER (WHERE dd IN (6, 13)) AS gwd, SUM(g) AS gall FROM gd), pi AS (SELECT product_id, COALESCE(SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE dd IN (6, 13)), 0) AS nwd, SUM(n) AS nall FROM pd GROUP BY product_id), ci AS (SELECT category_id, COALESCE(SUM(n) FILTER (WHERE dd IN (6, 13)), 0) AS nwd, SUM(n) AS nall FROM cd GROUP BY category_id), pc AS (SELECT product_id, ANY_VALUE(category_id) AS category_id FROM e GROUP BY product_id) SELECT pi.product_id, LN((pi.nwd + 1.0) / (pi.nall * gw.gwd / NULLIF(gw.gall, 0) + 1.0)) AS f_x_i_acq_weekday_lift_14d, LN((ci.nwd + 2.0) / (ci.nall * gw.gwd / NULLIF(gw.gall, 0) + 2.0)) AS f_x_i_cat_acq_weekday_lift_14d FROM pi JOIN pc ON pc.product_id = pi.product_id LEFT JOIN ci ON ci.category_id = pc.category_id CROSS JOIN gw

name: agent_night20_r4p4_cat_to_item_transition
idea: Category-to-item transition: the smoothed lift of P(user acquires item p after first viewing category c) over the base rate, learned over 14 days. It is applied from the user's 3 latest viewed categories to the top 25 items per category, which generalises the item-level view->acquisition links to whole-category browsing, including cross-category pulls.
sql: WITH vc AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, MIN(event_time) AS tv FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, category_id), ac AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MIN(event_time) AS ta FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, product_id), nu AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::DOUBLE AS n FROM vc), cn AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS nc FROM vc GROUP BY category_id), pn AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS np FROM ac GROUP BY product_id), co AS (SELECT vc.category_id AS c1, ac.product_id, COUNT(*) AS k FROM ac JOIN vc ON vc.user_id = ac.user_id AND vc.tv < ac.ta GROUP BY vc.category_id, ac.product_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), lf AS (SELECT c1, product_id, lift FROM (SELECT co.c1, co.product_id, co.k, (co.k + 1.0) / (cn.nc * pn.np / nu.n + 1.0) AS lift FROM co JOIN cn ON cn.category_id = co.c1 JOIN pn ON pn.product_id = co.product_id CROSS JOIN nu) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c1 ORDER BY lift * LN(1.0 + k) DESC) <= 25), seed AS (SELECT user_id, category_id AS c1, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, category_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 3) SELECT s.user_id, lf.product_id, MAX(LN(lf.lift)) AS f_x_ucp_cat2item_lift_max, SUM(LN(lf.lift) * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 24.0)) AS f_x_ucp_cat2item_lift_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN lf ON lf.c1 = s.c1 GROUP BY s.user_id, lf.product_id

name: agent_night20_r4p5_brand_switch_transition
idea: Within-category brand transitions: the smoothed lift of P(acquire brand b2 in category c after viewing brand b1 there) over the category base rate, covering both loyalty and switching. It is applied from the user's 2 latest viewed category+brand pairs to the top 15 acquired items of the 3 best follow-up brands.
sql: WITH vb AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand, MIN(event_time) AS tv FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, category_id, brand), ab AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand, MIN(event_time) AS ta FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, category_id, brand), n1 AS (SELECT category_id, brand AS b1, COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM vb GROUP BY category_id, brand), cv AS (SELECT category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::DOUBLE AS nv FROM vb GROUP BY category_id), n2 AS (SELECT category_id, brand AS b2, COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM ab GROUP BY category_id, brand), co AS (SELECT vb.category_id, vb.brand AS b1, ab.brand AS b2, COUNT(*) AS k FROM ab JOIN vb ON vb.user_id = ab.user_id AND vb.category_id = ab.category_id AND vb.tv < ab.ta GROUP BY vb.category_id, vb.brand, ab.brand HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), lf AS (SELECT category_id, b1, b2, lift FROM (SELECT co.category_id, co.b1, co.b2, (co.k + 1.0) / (n1.n1 * n2.n2 / cv.nv + 1.0) AS lift FROM co JOIN n1 ON n1.category_id = co.category_id AND n1.b1 = co.b1 JOIN n2 ON n2.category_id = co.category_id AND n2.b2 = co.b2 JOIN cv ON cv.category_id = co.category_id) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id, b1 ORDER BY lift DESC) <= 3), seed AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, brand AS b1, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, category_id, brand QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 2), tp AS (SELECT product_id, category_id, brand FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND brand IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY product_id, category_id, brand QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id, brand ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) DESC) <= 15) SELECT s.user_id, tp.product_id, MAX(LN(lf.lift)) AS f_x_ubt_brand_trans_lift_max, SUM(LN(lf.lift) * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 24.0)) AS f_x_ubt_brand_trans_lift_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN lf ON lf.category_id = s.category_id AND lf.b1 = s.b1 JOIN tp ON tp.category_id = lf.category_id AND tp.brand = lf.b2 GROUP BY s.user_id, tp.product_id

name: agent_night20_r5p1_cf_xday_new_acq_transition
idea: Item-item links that copy the target's structure: the smoothed lift of P(a user first touches and acquires item b within 24h on day d | the user viewed item a on day d-1 or d-2), learned over 14 days and applied from the user's 20 latest views of the last 48h; the target is new items acquired the next day, whereas the existing view->acquisition links are untimed.
sql: WITH acq AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MIN(event_time) AS tcp FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY user_id, product_id), ft AS (SELECT h.user_id, h.product_id, MIN(h.event_time) AS t0, ANY_VALUE(a.tcp) AS tcp FROM hist h JOIN acq a ON a.user_id = h.user_id AND a.product_id = h.product_id WHERE h.event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY h.user_id, h.product_id), na AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, CAST(date_diff('second', t0, TIMESTAMP '{t}') // 86400 AS INTEGER) AS d0 FROM ft WHERE tcp < t0 + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND t0 >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 12 DAY), vd AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id, CAST(date_diff('second', event_time, TIMESTAMP '{t}') // 86400 AS INTEGER) AS dd FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY), pp AS (SELECT DISTINCT n.user_id, v.product_id AS pa, n.product_id AS pb FROM na n JOIN vd v ON v.user_id = n.user_id AND v.dd BETWEEN n.d0 + 1 AND n.d0 + 2 AND v.product_id <> n.product_id), co AS (SELECT pa, pb, COUNT(*) AS k FROM pp GROUP BY pa, pb HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nav AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM vd GROUP BY product_id), nbc AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM na GROUP BY product_id), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS ud FROM (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, dd FROM vd)), lf AS (SELECT pa, pb, k, lift FROM (SELECT co.pa, co.pb, co.k, (co.k + 1.0) / (2.0 * x.n * y.n / tot.ud + 1.0) AS lift FROM co JOIN nav x ON x.product_id = co.pa JOIN nbc y ON y.product_id = co.pb CROSS JOIN tot) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY lift * LN(1.0 + k) DESC) <= 30), seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 20) SELECT s.user_id, lf.pb AS product_id, MAX(LN(lf.lift)) AS f_x_cf_xday_newacq_lift_max, SUM(LN(lf.lift) * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 24.0)) AS f_x_cf_xday_newacq_lift_tdecay, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS f_x_cf_xday_newacq_nseeds FROM seed s JOIN lf ON lf.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, lf.pb

name: agent_night20_r5p2_cf_next_view_adjacency
idea: Directional sequential links instead of whole-session co-occurrence: the probability that the next distinct item viewed in a session after a is b (7d, view-only, so the cart shift does not affect it), plus its lift over the popularity expectation, applied from the user's 5 latest viewed items with positional decay. This captures the click paths of the 'similar items' widget.
sql: WITH sq AS (SELECT product_id AS pa, LEAD(product_id) OVER (PARTITION BY user_session ORDER BY event_time) AS pb FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), tr AS (SELECT pa, pb, COUNT(*) AS k FROM sq WHERE pb IS NOT NULL AND pb <> pa GROUP BY pa, pb), od AS (SELECT pa, SUM(k)::DOUBLE AS n FROM tr GROUP BY pa), idg AS (SELECT pb, SUM(k)::DOUBLE AS n FROM tr GROUP BY pb), tot AS (SELECT SUM(k)::DOUBLE AS n FROM tr), seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, rn FROM (SELECT user_id, product_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) AS rn FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 3 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id) WHERE rn <= 5), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, p, lift FROM (SELECT tr.pa, tr.pb, tr.k / (o.n + 5.0) AS p, (tr.k + 1.0) / (o.n * i.n / tot.n + 1.0) AS lift FROM tr JOIN od o ON o.pa = tr.pa JOIN idg i ON i.pb = tr.pb CROSS JOIN tot WHERE tr.k >= 2 AND tr.pa IN (SELECT product_id FROM seed)) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY p DESC) <= 30) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, SUM(nb.p * POWER(0.6, s.rn - 1)) AS f_x_cf_nextview_p_pos, MAX(LN(nb.lift)) AS f_x_cf_nextview_lift_max FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r5p3_cf_converting_session_coview
idea: Co-view cosine computed only over 14d sessions of 2-40 items that ended in a cart or purchase, so links reflect alternatives that were seriously weighed against each other in a buying decision rather than casual browsing. It is applied to the user's 10 latest views with a 48h recency decay.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT user_session, product_id, MAX(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('cart','purchase') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acq FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL GROUP BY user_session, product_id), csess AS (SELECT user_session FROM s GROUP BY user_session HAVING MAX(acq) = 1 AND COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 40), sp AS (SELECT s.user_session, s.product_id FROM s JOIN csess ON csess.user_session = s.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM sp GROUP BY product_id), seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 10), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM sp a JOIN sp b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 30) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_convsess_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 48.0)) AS f_x_cf_convsess_cos_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r5p4_uc_nextday_continuation
idea: A category-specific and state-conditional conversion rate. It is learned as P(a user acquires in category c one or two days after viewing k distinct items of c on a day), with k bucketed by log2, and expressed as a lift over the global rate. It is evaluated at the user's own depth and lag in their 3 latest categories, then attached to the top 30 acquired products of each category. A tree cannot get this from uc_distinct_viewed and the category popularity features without knowing the category id.
sql: WITH vc AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, CAST(date_diff('second', event_time, TIMESTAMP '{t}') // 86400 AS INTEGER) AS dd, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS nv FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY 1, 2, 3), ac AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, category_id, CAST(date_diff('second', event_time, TIMESTAMP '{t}') // 86400 AS INTEGER) AS dd FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), ob AS (SELECT vc.category_id, vc.dd, LEAST(CAST(FLOOR(LOG2(vc.nv)) AS INTEGER), 4) AS b, CASE WHEN a1.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS y1, CASE WHEN a2.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS y2 FROM vc LEFT JOIN ac a1 ON a1.user_id = vc.user_id AND a1.category_id = vc.category_id AND a1.dd = vc.dd - 1 LEFT JOIN ac a2 ON a2.user_id = vc.user_id AND a2.category_id = vc.category_id AND a2.dd = vc.dd - 2 WHERE vc.dd >= 1), cb AS (SELECT category_id, b, SUM(y1) AS k1, COUNT(*) AS n1, COALESCE(SUM(y2) FILTER (WHERE dd >= 2), 0) AS k2, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dd >= 2) AS n2 FROM ob GROUP BY category_id, b), gb AS (SELECT b, SUM(k1)::DOUBLE / SUM(n1) AS p1, SUM(k2)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n2), 0) AS p2 FROM cb GROUP BY b), g AS (SELECT SUM(k1)::DOUBLE / SUM(n1) AS p1, SUM(k2)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(n2), 0) AS p2 FROM cb), rt AS (SELECT cb.category_id, cb.b, ((cb.k1 + 20.0 * gb.p1) / (cb.n1 + 20.0)) / g.p1 AS l1, ((cb.k2 + 20.0 * gb.p2) / (cb.n2 + 20.0)) / g.p2 AS l2, gb.p1 / g.p1 AS b1, gb.p2 / g.p2 AS b2 FROM cb JOIN gb ON gb.b = cb.b CROSS JOIN g), us AS (SELECT user_id, category_id, dd, nv FROM (SELECT user_id, category_id, dd, nv FROM vc WHERE dd <= 1 AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id, category_id ORDER BY dd) = 1) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY dd, nv DESC) <= 3), uv AS (SELECT us.user_id, us.category_id, CASE WHEN us.dd = 0 THEN rt.l1 ELSE rt.l2 END AS l, CASE WHEN us.dd = 0 THEN rt.b1 ELSE rt.b2 END AS bl FROM us JOIN rt ON rt.category_id = us.category_id AND rt.b = LEAST(CAST(FLOOR(LOG2(us.nv)) AS INTEGER), 4)), tp AS (SELECT category_id, product_id FROM (SELECT category_id, product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS n FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY category_id, product_id) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY n DESC) <= 30) SELECT uv.user_id, tp.product_id, MAX(LN(uv.l)) AS f_x_uc_nextday_cont_lift, MAX(LN(uv.l / uv.bl)) AS f_x_uc_nextday_cont_cat_excess FROM uv JOIN tp ON tp.category_id = uv.category_id GROUP BY uv.user_id, tp.product_id

name: agent_night20_r5p5_cf_considered_seed_coview
idea: Long-memory co-view seeds. It uses the user's 5 items with the most distinct revisit sessions over 14 days (at least 2), i.e. products they kept coming back to, which often fall outside the 20-latest-views window. It takes their 7d session co-view neighbours and weights them by log revisit count and a 96h recency decay. This extends the near-miss acquisition-seed idea to strong, uncommitted consideration.
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) AS ns, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) >= 2 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT user_session) DESC, MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 5), sp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), ss AS (SELECT user_session FROM sp GROUP BY user_session HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), spf AS (SELECT sp.user_session, sp.product_id FROM sp JOIN ss ON ss.user_session = sp.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM spf GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM spf a JOIN spf b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 30) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_consid_cv_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * LN(1.0 + s.ns) * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 96.0)) AS f_x_cf_consid_cv_wsum FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r6p1_older_view_seed_coview
idea: Long-memory co-view: session co-view neighbours (7d, sessions of 2-30 items) of the user's distinct viewed items ranked 21-40 by recency over 14 days, which fall just outside the existing 20-latest-views window, weighted by a 120h recency decay; this extends the accepted revisit-seed idea to the rest of the user's older browsing.
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, lt FROM (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) AS rn FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id) WHERE rn BETWEEN 21 AND 40), sp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), ss AS (SELECT user_session FROM sp GROUP BY user_session HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), spf AS (SELECT sp.user_session, sp.product_id FROM sp JOIN ss ON ss.user_session = sp.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM spf GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM spf a JOIN spf b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 15) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_oldview_cv_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 120.0)) AS f_x_cf_oldview_cv_wsum, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS f_x_cf_oldview_cv_nseeds FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r6p2_dwell_seed_coview
idea: Consideration seeds selected by attention rather than revisits or recency: the user's 5 items with the largest total page dwell (time to the next event in the session, capped at 300 s, at least 60 s total) over 7 days, expanded to their 7d session co-view neighbours and weighted by log dwell and a 72h decay.
sql: WITH e AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, event_type, event_time, date_diff('second', event_time, LEAD(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY user_session ORDER BY event_time)) AS dt FROM hist WHERE event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users)), seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, SUM(LEAST(dt, 300)) AS dw, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM e WHERE event_type = 'view' AND dt IS NOT NULL AND dt >= 0 GROUP BY user_id, product_id HAVING SUM(LEAST(dt, 300)) >= 60 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY SUM(LEAST(dt, 300)) DESC) <= 5), sp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), ss AS (SELECT user_session FROM sp GROUP BY user_session HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), spf AS (SELECT sp.user_session, sp.product_id FROM sp JOIN ss ON ss.user_session = sp.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM spf GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM spf a JOIN spf b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 30) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_dwell_cv_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * LN(1.0 + s.dw / 60.0) * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 72.0)) AS f_x_cf_dwell_cv_wsum FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r6p3_abandoned_cart_seed_coview
idea: Substitute search after an abandoned cart: session co-view neighbours (7d) of the user's 5 latest items that were carted in the last 7 days but never purchased, with a 48h recency decay. An unfinished cart signals an open need that the user may close with an alternative, unlike purchased seeds, which mix in complements.
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type IN ('cart','purchase') AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'purchase') = 0 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 5), sp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), ss AS (SELECT user_session FROM sp GROUP BY user_session HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), spf AS (SELECT sp.user_session, sp.product_id FROM sp JOIN ss ON ss.user_session = sp.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM spf GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM spf a JOIN spf b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 30) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_abandon_cv_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 48.0)) AS f_x_cf_abandon_cv_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r6p4_user_level_cooccurrence_cf
idea: Cross-session item-item links: a cosine over users (with 2-60 distinct viewed items in 14 days) who viewed both items at any time, not necessarily in the same session. It is applied to the user's 5 latest views of the last 48h with a 24h decay, and it captures items people return to compare on later days, which session co-view misses.
sql: WITH ui AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY), uu AS (SELECT user_id FROM ui GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 60), uif AS (SELECT ui.user_id, ui.product_id FROM ui JOIN uu ON uu.user_id = ui.user_id), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM uif GROUP BY product_id), seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 5), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM uif a JOIN uif b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 20) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_uco_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 24.0)) AS f_x_cf_uco_cos_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb

name: agent_night20_r6p5_fresh_2d_coview_graph
idea: A fresh co-view graph built only from the last 48h of sessions (2-30 items), applied to the user's 5 latest views with a 12h decay. It catches links that only formed in the last two days around new launches, promotions or restocks, which are diluted in the 7-14d graphs; it is view-only, so it is immune to the cart shift.
sql: WITH seed AS (SELECT user_id, product_id, MAX(event_time) AS lt FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM active_users) GROUP BY user_id, product_id QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY MAX(event_time) DESC) <= 5), sp AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_session, product_id FROM hist WHERE event_type = 'view' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '{t}' - INTERVAL 2 DAY AND user_session IS NOT NULL), ss AS (SELECT user_session FROM sp GROUP BY user_session HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 2 AND 30), spf AS (SELECT sp.user_session, sp.product_id FROM sp JOIN ss ON ss.user_session = sp.user_session), deg AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS n FROM spf GROUP BY product_id), pr AS (SELECT a.product_id AS pa, b.product_id AS pb, COUNT(*) AS co FROM spf a JOIN spf b ON a.user_session = b.user_session AND a.product_id <> b.product_id WHERE a.product_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM seed) GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2), nb AS (SELECT pa, pb, cosv FROM (SELECT pr.pa, pr.pb, pr.co / SQRT(d1.n * d2.n) AS cosv FROM pr JOIN deg d1 ON d1.product_id = pr.pa JOIN deg d2 ON d2.product_id = pr.pb) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pa ORDER BY cosv DESC) <= 20) SELECT s.user_id, nb.pb AS product_id, MAX(nb.cosv) AS f_x_cf_cv2d_cos_max, SUM(nb.cosv * EXP(-date_diff('second', s.lt, TIMESTAMP '{t}') / 3600.0 / 12.0)) AS f_x_cf_cv2d_cos_tdecay FROM seed s JOIN nb ON nb.pa = s.product_id GROUP BY s.user_id, nb.pb
